name: Trading Card Gallery
description: Row of thumbnail tiles that open a full-screen modal with a 3D collectible trading card. The card flips in, tilts toward the mouse, and slides sideways with a spin when browsing prev or next.
contents: Row of colored thumbnail tiles, one per card
Modal overlay with a 3D card showing pixel art, logo, number, description and QR code
Close, Prev and Next round buttons
behavior: Clicking a tile fades in a white overlay and flips the card in from below with a spin
Card tilts toward the mouse pointer with eased following
Prev and Next slide the current card out with a 360 degree spin and bring in the neighbor, wrapping at the ends
Close drops the card down and fades the overlay out
Below 640px the Prev and Next buttons move to the bottom and the card scales to 80vw
editableByProps: Card descriptions, card face colors, side riser colors and logo fill color per card
Which built-in artwork, logo, number and QR symbol each card uses, by id

needsCodeEdit.change: Add new card artwork, logos, numbers or QR codes
needsCodeEdit.where: The hidden svg blocks containing symbol elements with ids ghoul-1 to ghoul-4, logo-adamn, logo-choke, logo-evel, logo-1, no-1 and qr-1

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the card back face and header logo
needsCodeEdit.where: symbol ids back-logo and ghoul-logo, and the gg-back class in the style block
The fromTo on modalRef.current inside openModal
speed constant and the multipliers 40 and -40 in tiltSetterRef

fixed: Card artwork, logos, number and QR are built-in SVG symbols referenced by id, so ids must be unique per page
Modal is fixed to the viewport and covers the page when open
Card size is fixed at 450 by 650 and shrinks to 80vw on small screens
Tilt follows the window mouse position, so there is no tilt on touch devices
